full_judgment:
ATM Afzal CJ : Plaintiff-Appellants of Civil Appeal No. 48 of 1995 filed Other Suit No. 168 of 1985 against the defendant-respondents in the First Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong for a declaration of title to recovery of khas possession in some part and also for confirmation of possession in the rest of the suit land. Defendant-respondent No. 1 Sreemati Shaibalini Ghosh filed SCC suits against the appellants for their eviction as tenants from the suit land originally in the First Court of Munsif, Chittagong which on transfer to the First Court of Subordinate Judge were registered as SCC Suit Nos. 13-17 of 1988. 

 10. It was argued on behalf of the plaintiff-appellants in the High Court Division that the aforesaid decision 38 DLR (AD) 97 has no manner of application in the facts and circumstances of the present case as that was a decision in an SCC suit, whereas the present suit by the plaintiffs was one for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession (in 3rd Schedule) and the defendant's SCC suits for eviction of the plaintiffs were tried along with the title suit as a matter of convenience and therefore a decision on the merit as to the plaintiff's title cannot be deferred until surrendering possession as in the cited case. It was also argued that the plaintiffs had purchased paramount title in the suit property from the original landlords and Sadananda Ghose had not acquired or could not acquire any valid title to the property either through Ext. 3 or Ext.1 (1).
